leadText:
A Viscount (Japanese: ヴァイカウント Viscount) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in Generation VI. This Trainer class is a title of nobility, granted in the Battle Chateau, and Trainers with this class only appear there. Viscount is the second lowest rank of nobility for males, ranking above and below . Its counterpart for females is .

The male player character may earn the title of Viscount by winning enough s in the Battle Chateau. All opponent Viscounts use parties of one Pokémon at level 20 (if no is active).
